entry.title: River City Ramblers RVA, October 31
entry.content:
From River City Ramblers RVA




HEY RAMBLERS WE GOT SOME NEW CHANGES IN NOVEMBER !!! 🍂🌰🐿️ ⬇️

✨ All Sunday Rambles in November will begin at 10:15 AM with meet up starting at 10 AM ! This is to accommodate for the change in early morning temps 🥶

✨ We will have NO RAMBLE TOMORROW NOVEMBER 1st — Happy Halloween Ramblers, have fun & be safe! 👻

✨ On SATURDAY, November 7th we will be hosting a 14 mile out-and-back ramble on the Fall Line Trail! We’ll meet up at 9am in Ashland with the ramble beginning at 9:15am. If you haven’t been on the Fall Line Trail yet, this is a great chance to get out there with friends for a safe, no-drop, social-pace ride! (In collaboration with @bikewalkrva 🚲)

✨ On Saturday, November 21st we encourage everyone to join @rvacranksgiving for an opportunity to ride bikes and give back to our community! 🤗 Check out their page for more info!

YAY! What a fun month ahead — if you’re reading this, save this post, follow our page and mark your calendars! We can’t wait to ramble with you 🥰

& DM us if you have any questions!

entry.title: River City Ramblers RVA, October 15
entry.content:
From River City Ramblers RVA





WOO HOO! It’s a celebrationnnn 🗣️🥳🎂🎈

This past Sunday we gathered to celebrate River City Rambler’s 2nd birthday!!! Wow, what an incredible two years it has been. Our group has grown in ways that we never could have imagined and never could have accomplished without the amazing community that shows up for us week by week. 🤗

A very special thank you to the ramblers that braved the rain on Sunday and rambled to Dogwood Dell to live, laugh, and love RCR. We had juice, bagels, cream cheese, fruit, AND a GIANT donut from Sugar Shack 😋

Now, this upcoming Sunday, October 18th is our last ramble of the month! 🥹 AND it also happens to be our ✨ Raffle Ramble ✨

HOW TO ENTER:
1. Head on over to our pinned post on our page - it’s our October schedule post!
2. Hit like on the October schedule post!
3. Make sure you’re currently following @river_city_ramblers_rva
4. Tag a friend in the comments of our October schedule post!

HOW TO WIN:
1. Enter
2. Show up on Sunday!

Good luck ramblers 🤩

entry.title: River City Ramblers RVA, October 1
entry.content:
From River City Ramblers RVA





Happy October Ramblers! 👻🎃🍭🧙‍♀️

October is a very special month for us because we are celebrating 2 YEARS since the first ride we had on October 8th 2024! Watching this community grow and evolve into what it is today has been so special. We are so thankful for each and every rambler, and we hope you’ll come celebrate with us at our 2-year-rambler-versary ride on Sunday, October 11th 2026. 🥳

Then, to keep the celebration going, we are having a raffle ramble on Sunday, October 18th where one lucky rambler will win a bag full of cycling goodies from local RVA shops! All you have to do to enter is:
1. Like this post
2. Follow @river_city_ramblers_rva
3. Tag a cycling buddy below

TO WIN you must be present at the raffle ramble on October 18th 🤗🚲 GOOD LUCK RAMBLERS!

As always, all rambles will begin at 9:15 with 9:00 as the recommended arrival time. Our rambles are social-pace, beginner-friendly, with minimal hills, and an average of 8-10 miles. All ages and all levels are welcome! If you have any questions about our group, feel free to shoot us a DM or contact us on Facebook. We also have a GroupMe where we post about other cycling events going on in the area and stay connected. ☺️

If you like what you see, go ahead and give this post a like, give @river_city_ramblers_rva a follow, and you’re only one step away from winning some new gear 👀

See you on Sunday!

entry.title: River City Ramblers RVA, September 26
entry.content:
From River City Ramblers RVA





Better late than never! Here are a few flicks from the ramble last Sunday 🚲

Your RCR social media manager was out of town and missed both the ramble and post-ramble festivities…so she has few details to share. That being said, it looks like the weather was nice and the ramble had a great turnout!

There are no documented photos from the post-ramble Oktoberfest festivities, (likely due to fun-maxxing), but I’m sure it was a blast and I’ll forever cheers to cycling and community! 🍻

Oh and next year, I will be wearing my Lederhosen, just you wait….

Thanks for coming out and we hope to see you THIS SUNDAY for our last ride of September! We’ll be meeting up at the VMFA around 9 AM and begin the ramble around 9:15 AM. If you have any questions, need some bike maintenance, or just want to chat, make sure to arrive early!

DM us if you have any questions for us or would like to collab! <3

entry.title: River City Ramblers RVA, September 17
entry.content:
From River City Ramblers RVA





Another successful ramble in the books! And the rain stayed away for us 🙌

This past Sunday we completed about 8 miles, rambling through the Fan, over to Monroe, and over to Byrd before heading back to the VMFA. Despite the cloudy weather and potential rain, we had a great turnout and we even saw some new rambling faces! WELCOME AND THANKS FOR JOINING! 🤗 WE HOPE TO SEE YOU AGAIN!

This upcoming weekend is one of our favorite fall weekends because it is OKTOBERFEST at St Benedicts! To celebrate, we will be rambling on Sunday from around 9:15am-11:00am ish and then meeting up at the fest around noon! We encourage you to get your lederhosen out, start practicing for the stein hold, and prepare your stomachs for a good time. 🥨🍻

If you have any questions about the ramble or the post-ramble festivities, feel free to comment or shoot us a DM!

We hope to see you all this Sunday! Prost!
